decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch sits close to the core craft offer, was featured on the home page in both observed years, and in a growing industry with likely slack it meets aspirations well enough to keep.
A one-tier Christmas pyramid is a staple of the firm's established line; such seasonal pieces usually stay in the range for years and give no shortfall that would trigger search.

The electronic music box is distant from the core craft, but it was promoted on the home page and is the base for follow-up disc releases, so its apparent success and the firm's slack justify carrying it despite some uncertainty.
A second edition of this motif platform signals demand above aspiration, though motif-based items are easily rotated for newer motifs, so the risk of dropping is moderate.
The Christmas motif platform fits the seasonal core market and extends the music box system, and with no evidence of a performance shortfall there is no pressure to drop it.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds directly on the firm's established offer and its traditional, collectible appeal, making it a dependable seller that management would keep.
